title: HRMS Workflows & Performance Analytics
summary: Built automated appraisal workflows, real-time employee utilization tracking, and objective performance-linked incentive calculators to streamline HR operations and align rewards with project outcomes.

projectItems.title: HRMS Optimization & Utilization Analytics
projectItems.summary: Connected Zoho People and Creator to track billable vs available resource utilization, automate appraisal evaluation cycles, and standardize performance scorecards.
projectItems.problemStatement: HR and delivery leads had limited visibility into actual resource utilization across teams. Appraisals were managed manually via forms, evaluation criteria varied by manager, and appraisal schedules were frequently delayed.
projectItems.solution: Built a Zoho People-Creator sync layer calculating utilization metrics (billable hours ÷ available hours) by individual, department, and project. Created an automated appraisal manager with scheduled evaluation triggers, manager review forms, and progress tracking.
projectItems.impact: Standardized the appraisal cycle across departments and provided management with real-time utilization visibility for staffing and performance reviews.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Links HR employee data directly with delivery utilization, giving leadership objective insights for staffing and appraisal decisions.

projectItems.title: Performance-Linked Incentive Calculation Engine
projectItems.summary: Engineered an automated incentive engine calculating payouts based on weighted KPIs (utilization, project delivery quality, customer feedback) with multi-tier approval routing.
projectItems.problemStatement: Incentive calculations were done manually on spreadsheets, leading to delays and potential calculation errors. Employees lacked clarity on how bonuses were calculated, and managers had to manually gather inputs from multiple systems.
projectItems.solution: Built a Creator incentive application that automatically fetches utilization data, project completion rates, and quality scores. Calculates weighted composite scores and routes payout calculations through Manager, HR, and Finance approval stages.
projectItems.impact: Eliminated manual spreadsheet calculation errors, reduced payout processing time, and provided employees with transparent performance-to-payout scorecards.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Automates variable pay calculations using clear operational metrics, creating transparency for employees and auditability for finance.
